description: TOCTOU: fs.exists check and fs.readFile are separate non-atomic operations — file can be deleted between check and read
notes: fs.exists deprecated precisely because of this TOCTOU pattern. Real fix: fs.readFile directly and handle ENOENT.

description: Connection error fires callback, then query timeout also fires callback — same cb called twice
notes: Missing return before cb(err) in error branch — connection proceeds to query even after error.

description: Callback invoked synchronously on cache hit but asynchronously on cache miss — inconsistent timing
notes: Classic Zalgo. Fix: wrap sync path in process.nextTick(() => callback(null, cache[key]))

description: Synchronous CPU-intensive loop inside Express middleware blocks event loop — all other requests starve
notes: Fix: offload to worker_threads or break into chunks with setImmediate.

description: Class method passed as middleware without bind — this is lost when Express calls the function
notes: Fix: app.get('/user/:id', ctrl.getUser.bind(ctrl)) or arrow function: app.get('/user/:id', (req,res) => ctrl.getUser(req,res))

description: Connection pool deadlock — error path does nested pool.query for rollback without releasing original connection
notes: done() not called on all error paths — connection leaks back to pool. Pool exhaustion under load.

description: Piped stream chain has no error handlers — if transform errors, source stream never destroyed, fd leak
notes: Fix: use stream.pipeline(readStream, gzip, res, callback) which handles cleanup automatically.

description: Concurrent login requests share session — req.user set by one request visible to another before commit
notes: Session store write is async but response sent immediately — concurrent requests can read stale session.

description: Rejected promise inside generator not caught — falls through to unhandled rejection
notes: Missing .catch() — if db.connect() or conn.query() rejects, process emits unhandledRejection.

description: Readable stream consumed faster than writable can accept — buffer grows unbounded, OOM
notes: writableDB.write() returns false when buffer full but stream not paused. Fix: use .pipe() or check write() return and pause/resume.

description: Timeout handler and response handler both invoke the same callback
notes: If server responds after timeout fires, cb called twice. Fix: clearTimeout(timer) before cb(err, data).

description: Three independent DB queries awaited sequentially — total latency = sum of all three instead of max
notes: All three queries are independent — Promise.all() reduces latency from ~300ms to ~100ms.

description: Job status check and job processing are non-atomic — two workers can pick up same job
notes: status check + update not atomic in Redis — two workers both see 'pending' simultaneously.

description: Deeply nested callbacks with unclear error propagation — 4+ levels, errors silently dropped
notes: callback(null, results) fires before transform() callbacks finish — results array incomplete.

description: Unbounded Promise.all over large user list — creates thousands of HTTP connections simultaneously
notes: With 10,000 users creates 10,000 simultaneous HTTP connections. Fix: use p-limit(10) or chunk into batches.

description: pbkdf2Sync used in request handler — blocks entire event loop for duration of hash computation (~100ms)
notes: Sync crypto in request handler blocks all concurrent requests. Fix: crypto.pbkdf2() async version.

description: Series task fires callback sync when value pre-computed, async otherwise — stack overflow possible on deep recursion
notes: On all-cache-hit input, recursion is fully sync — stack overflow for large arrays.

description: Async route handler throws — Express 4 does not catch async errors, process emits unhandledRejection
notes: If db.findUser() rejects, Express 4 never catches it. Fix: wrap in try/catch or use express-async-errors.

description: Check file existence then create — race window between check and create allows two processes to both create
notes: Fix: use fs.writeFile with flag 'wx' (exclusive create) — atomic operation.

description: Class method inside setTimeout uses regular function — this is global/undefined in strict mode
notes: Both this.data and this.interval are undefined inside function(). Also uses deprecated arguments.callee.
